headline: Messi scores 14th World Cup goal as Argentina leads Algeria
summary: Lionel Messi finds the net in his record sixth World Cup appearance, helping Argentina take an early lead against Algeria.
details: Lionel Messi scored his 14th World Cup goal as Argentina took an early lead against Algeria in their opening match of the tournament.
The Argentinian side entered the first half with a strong attacking lineup, featuring Messi and Lautaro Martinez as the primary strikers.

For Algeria, Riyad Mahrez started on the bench, with Anis Hadj Moussa taking his place in the attacking line.

Messi's goal ensured Argentina ended the first half with a lead, setting the momentum for the tournament opener.
caption:
Messi hits his 14th World Cup goal! 🇦🇷

Lionel Messi scored his 14th World Cup goal as Argentina took an early lead against Algeria in their opening match of the tournament.

The Argentinian side entered the first half with a strong attacking lineup, featuring Messi and Lautaro Martinez as the primary strikers.

Coach Lionel Scaloni opted to start Lautaro Martinez over Julian Alvarez, who remained on the bench despite being available after recovering from an ankle injury.

Argentina's starting XI included Emiliano Martinez, Gonzalo Montiel, Lisandro Martinez, and Cristian Romero, in a midfield of De Paul, Mac Allister, and Enzo Fernandez.

For Algeria, Riyad Mahrez started on the bench, with Anis Hadj Moussa taking his place in the attacking line.

The match saw early tension with two goals disallowed for Argentina within the first eight minutes of play.

Messi's goal ensured Argentina ended the first half with a lead, setting the momentum for the tournament opener.

headline_marked: Haaland double powers [[Norway to 4-1 win over Iraq]] in World Cup return
headline: Haaland double powers Norway to 4-1 win over Iraq in World Cup return
summary: Erling Haaland scored twice as Norway secured a dominant victory in their first major tournament appearance in 26 years.
details: Erling Haaland scored his first World Cup goals in a 4-1 victory for Norway against Iraq on Tuesday in Boston. This marks Norway's first appearance at a major tournament in 26 years.
Haaland opened the scoring in the 29th minute, and although Aymen Hussein equalized for Iraq with a header, Haaland pounced on a defensive error before half-time to restore the lead.
Leo Ostigard added a third goal shortly after coming off the bench, and a late own goal by Hussein sealed the 4-1 win for the Norwegians.
The result puts Norway at the top of Group I on goal difference, level on three points with France, who beat Senegal 3-1 earlier in the day.
Norway's next match will be against France in New Jersey on June 22, as they look to capitalize on a golden generation led by Haaland and Martin Odegaard.
For Iraq, the match followed a grueling 21-match qualifying campaign that lasted 867 days, making them the 48th and final qualifiers for the tournament.
caption:
Erling Haaland makes a thunderous World Cup debut! 🇳🇴

Erling Haaland scored his first World Cup goals in a 4-1 victory for Norway against Iraq on Tuesday in Boston. This marks Norway's first appearance at a major tournament in 26 years.

Haaland opened the scoring in the 29th minute, and although Aymen Hussein equalized for Iraq with a header, Haaland pounced on a defensive error before half-time to restore the lead.

Leo Ostigard added a third goal shortly after coming off the bench, and a late own goal by Hussein sealed the 4-1 win for the Norwegians.

The result puts Norway at the top of Group I on goal difference, level on three points with France, who beat Senegal 3-1 earlier in the day.

Norway's next match will be against France in New Jersey on June 22, as they look to capitalize on a golden generation led by Haaland and Martin Odegaard.

For Iraq, the match followed a grueling 21-match qualifying campaign that lasted 867 days, making them the 48th and final qualifiers for the tournament.
